_comment: Documentation only: any file whose name starts with an underscore other than _default.json is skipped. Copy this to merchants/<merchant_id>.json (PaymentAttempt.merchant_id, e.g. merchant_acme.json), delete this _comment key (unknown keys are rejected), and keep only the fields you mean to change. Every field is optional. Schema and the invariants a file cannot break: docs/merchants.md.
